The footer links instagram.com/myplants.uae, tiktok.com/@myplants.uae and facebook.com/myplants.uae.

The Instagram account is the marketing channel of a Dubai landscaping contractor. Services pages: landscaping design & build, '2D & 3D Landscaping Design', garden and indoor-plant maintenance, pools and water features, outdoor structures, green walls, irrigation. Quotes after site assessment; '🖼️ Free Design Previews'. About page: founded by Kashif Taj, Managing Partner Tom Edwards, nursery in Warsan 3, Dubai.

AI inspiration reels used as lead generation for the build business. Caption of DYQ3I3fMJkN: 'AI-generated inspiration brought to life by MyPlants. Would you build this in your garden? 👀 #Dubai #DubaiGardens #DubaiHomes #LandscapeDesign #MyPlantsDubai'. Caption of DYPJn3DMuaV (15.6M views on the topic page, '246,948 likes' on the embed page): 'AI-generated, but we'd absolutely build this in Dubai. What would you add to this garden?'.

The YouTube channel of the same brand (description lists 'Website: myplants.ae' and 'WhatsApp: +971 58 508 4788') describes: 'Get on-demand landscaping, garden & plant maintenance services in Dubai. Instantly book our top-rated team today. Shop a wide variety of indoor & outdoor plants, pots, and accessories online.' Its Shorts reuse the Instagram caption format ('Send this to someone who...'), e.g. 'Send this to someone who’d love a garden like this 🌿🏡' (6.6K views).
The TikTok account @myplants.uae is flagged as a commerce (business) account in its public SSR data ('commerceUser': true, category 'Others'); bio link https://myplants.ae.

DYPJn3DMuaV: 'AI-generated, but we'd absolutely build this in Dubai'. The project's cover-frame coding marks both as ai_generated (ai_disclosed = true). niche_focus: Dubai plant e-commerce and landscaping contractor that posts AI-generated luxury garden, courtyard and pool concepts ('we'd absolutely build this in Dubai') to generate landscaping leads.
cta_pattern: Bio CTA UNKNOWN. Captions follow a fixed template: share hook 'Send this to someone who...' + short scene description + an AI disclosure tied to the brand ('AI-generated inspiration brought to life by MyPlants' / 'AI-generated, but we'd absolutely build this in Dubai') + a comment question ('Would you build this in your garden? 👀' / 'What would you add to this garden? 👀') + 5 hashtags ending in #MyPlantsDubai. The same 'Send this to someone who...' template dominates the YouTube Shorts titles. Conversion path: website with WhatsApp, form and 'Free Design Previews'.
